organization: European Network of Transmission System Operators for Electricity
geographic_scope: European electricity market areas (35+ bidding zones)
academic_relevance: Primary source for hourly European electricity demand; official TSO-verified data. Widely cited in academic literature.
notes: Correct base URL: https://web-api.tp.entsoe.eu/api. Parameter: outBiddingZone_Domain (NOT outBzn_Domain). GB data limited post-Brexit Jan 2021.

academic_relevance: Primary source for GB half-hourly electricity demand; official data from grid operator. Replaces National Grid ESO branding.
notes: NESO was rebranded from National Grid ESO in 2024. Dataset: historic-demand-data. Columns: ND (National Demand) and TSD (Transmission System Demand).

academic_relevance: Official U.S. federal energy statistics; authoritative for US electricity demand research.
notes: API v2 endpoint: https://api.eia.gov/v2/electricity/rto/region-data/data/ Respondent US48 = contiguous US aggregate.

academic_relevance: Primary source for Australian NEM 5-minute electricity dispatch data; official market operator.
notes: Western Australia (SWIS) is separate from NEM and not covered by this endpoint.

academic_relevance: Widely used in academic and policy research for global electricity demand comparisons across 215+ countries.
notes: API key required for programmatic access. Bulk CSV also available from Ember Open Data Catalogue.

academic_relevance: Standard reference for cross-country macroeconomic and demographic panel data in energy economics research.
Standard climate data source for energy demand research; MERRA-2 reanalysis. Covers T2M / solar / wind / precipitation globally.
notes: Sentinel value: -999.0 indicates missing observation. Clamp start year to 1981 minimum.

academic_relevance: Lightweight and reliable public holiday calendar API used in electricity demand feature engineering.
Gold standard reanalysis for climate research; higher resolution than NASA POWER but requires CDS API key and bulk extraction.
notes: Requires CDS_API_KEY and cdsapi Python library. Bulk extraction only — not suitable for real-time individual queries.

academic_relevance: Standard climate scenario data for long-term electricity demand projections under SSP pathways.
notes: Research tier only. Requires CDS_API_KEY. Batch extraction required.

organization: International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis
academic_relevance: Standard long-term demographic and economic scenario data for energy system modeling.
notes: No public REST API. Download via IIASA SSP DB portal or pyam library.

dataset_name: Gridded Population of the World v4
academic_relevance: Gridded population raster for spatial electricity demand analysis.
notes: No API. Manual download required from NASA SEDAC. Research tier only.
